pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition on adding to losing positions or placing multiple sequential market orders within a 5-minute window; all subsequent scaling must occur exclusively on verified, trend-confirmed profit pullbacks.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory ATR-based volatility envelope check: entry is strictly blocked if the current 1-minute candle range exceeds 2.5x the 20-period average true range, preventing execution directly into high-impact news wicks.
profit_harvest_threshold: Immediate partial profit lock-in when floating profit reaches +$5.00, converting remaining position to break-even plus trailing stop to systematically target $15-$30+ expansions.
